segformer_pretrained: the PRETRAINED checkpoint is a large download; the architecture family is covered from scratch by segnext_lite / vit_seg / swin_lite below
transunet_pretrained: needs pretrained ImageNet ViT weights; the hybrid conv+attention family is covered from scratch by axial_unet and swin_lite
resnet_unet_pretrained: torchvision pretrained backbone requires a weights download; resunet covers the residual-encoder family from scratch
sam: Segment-Anything foundation model: multi-GB checkpoint, impractical locally
vision_mamba: state-space vision models need custom CUDA kernels; no usable MPS implementation
diffusion_segmentation: iterative denoising costs orders of magnitude more compute than the whole sweep combined
